description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named `QuestionController` which manages CRUD operations for questions using a `QuestionRepository`. It provides endpoints to get, create, update, and delete questions.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations for questions via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a question by ID, throws exception if not found.
